
## 效果量與 score 信賴區間（Agresti §2.2–2.3）

```{r}
s <- {{success}}                       # 「成功」的類別
y1 <- tab[1, s]; n1 <- sum(tab[1, ])
y2 <- tab[2, s]; n2 <- sum(tab[2, ])
p1 <- y1 / n1; p2 <- y2 / n2
ci <- rbind(PropCIs::diffscoreci(y1, n1, y2, n2, conf.level = {{conf}})$conf.int,
            PropCIs::riskscoreci(y1, n1, y2, n2, conf.level = {{conf}})$conf.int,
            PropCIs::orscoreci(y1, n1, y2, n2, conf.level = {{conf}})$conf.int)
data.frame(量數 = c("比例差", "相對風險", "勝算比"),
           估計值 = c(p1 - p2, p1 / p2, (y1 * (n2 - y2)) / ((n1 - y1) * y2)),
           下限 = ci[, 1], 上限 = ci[, 2])
```
